description: Returns the link to the Custom Blinds measuring guide when a customer is unsure how to measure. There is no AR tool: the guide shows how to measure for an inside (recess) or outside (face fix) fit in two minutes, and a customer who is still unsure can order with best guess sizes, receive a free tape measure and confirm before production starts.

mode.description: Which tool to surface. Default: both.

product_id.description: Optional. Pre-select a product in the visualizer (e.g. roller-blockout, venetian-25mm-aluwood).

name: get_ar_visualizer_url
